name: Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum
description: Imagine being able to enjoy a moment of togetherness with your horse and receiving beautiful photos that perfectly capture these moments of happiness and trust. Let me accompany you in this moment. Calmly and with a lot of peace and mindfulness, I will follow you and your horse like a shadow and capture your loving relationship in photographs. This way, you can focus solely on your horse and your bond.
